memory_candidates.content: When generate-context-line-counts.sh --write must run against the SOURCE store (agent-system/extensions/<ext>/index-entries.json) rather than a deployed .claude/scripts/ copy, it refuses by default with a deploy-root-guard error. Bypass with `REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write` -- the script explicitly supports this bypass for a deliberate source-store invocation, and it is the only way to regenerate line_count drift without a full redeploy first.

git-commit-scoped.sh's V10 file_scope-Containment guard is opt-in via the --task flag. When git-commit-phase.sh drops a files_touched path as out-of-scope and deposits it into proposed_file_scope, the mechanical follow-up commit MUST invoke git-commit-scoped.sh WITHOUT --task -- passing --task re-triggers the same containment check against the same still-unwidened declared file_scope and refuses the commit a second time with 'zero positive pathspec entries remain'.
